algorithm: CA-BOSS v4.42 cross-context alternative-set component ambiguity graph equivalence

method_contract.state_source: held-out background features within each assay
method_contract.contexts: full fit plus two disjoint background-feature folds
method_contract.reporter_stability: 128 within-assay cell bootstraps in every context with Bonferroni runner-up tests
method_contract.exact_two_assay_participation: requires statistical and reporter-bootstrap support in all three contexts
method_contract.alternative_set_rescue: when exactly one statistical context disagrees but all reporter bootstraps pass, retain the focal pair plus non-core directly matched partners from the disagreeing context only if at least two alternatives exist
method_contract.alternative_set_semantics: one set-valued shared-state hyperedge; never expand alternatives into edges, exact participation, or direction

published_method_inspiration.primary: Sturma, Squires, Drton, and Uhler (NeurIPS 2023), Unpaired Multi-Domain Causal Representation Learning
published_method_inspiration.relationship: The rank-three ICA/KS implementation is a diagnostic adaptation, not a direct theorem application; the cached Poisson count simulation violates the paper's noiseless injective linear-ICA assumptions.
additional: Silva et al. (JMLR 2006), Learning the Structure of Linear Latent Variable Models
Triantafillou and Tsamardinos (JMLR 2015), Constraint-based Causal Discovery from Multiple Interventions over Overlapping Variable Sets
Tillman and Spirtes (AAAI 2011), Learning Equivalence Classes of Acyclic Models with Latent and Selection Variables from Multiple Datasets with Overlapping Variables
